about_the_game:
🕵️‍♂️ Exit Strategy

Sneak out. Don’t get caught. Build the perfect office escape.

🎮 Play the Free Demo NOW for Steam Next Fest!

Try Exit Strategy today and wishlist to get notified when Early Access begins June 17.

💼 You’ve had enough work for one day…

Your boss doesn’t agree. In Exit Strategy, you’ll need to sneak, sabotage, and slither your way out of the office without getting caught. Avoid the boss. Dodge HR. Distract your coworkers. And for extra credit? Nab your paycheck on the way out.

  • 🧠 Solve stealth puzzles with hilarious office obstacles

  • 🥷 Use vents, lockers, water spills, and coffee chaos to your advantage

  • 😈 Evade a reactive boss who learns and adapts to your tricks

  • 📈 Optional objectives = bigger bragging rights

🛠️ Build Mode: Create and Share Your Own Escapes

When you're not escaping, you're designing. Jump into Build Mode to craft your own devious office layouts using dozens of props and gameplay objects. Then upload to the Steam Workshop and challenge the world.

  • 🧱 Place walls, desks, microwaves, paychecks, patrol routes, and more

  • 🧑‍💼 Test coworker behavior, boss patrols, and hiding spots

  • 🌐 Full Steam Workshop support (Early Access only)

👀 What to Expect in Early Access

This is a solo-dev stealth puzzle game with a growing community. During Early Access, you’ll help shape the direction of:

  • 🏢 New office props and prank tools

  • 🤖 Improved AI and unique coworker personalities

  • 🎯 More missions and leaderboard challenges

  • 🧩 Enhanced Build Mode mechanics

🎭 Inspired by stealth classics and The Office-style absurdity

Exit Strategy blends classic stealth gameplay with workplace satire. It's chaotic, clever, and oddly relatable for anyone who's ever counted the hours ‘til quitting time.

🛎️ Join the Community

📣 Share ideas, report bugs, and post your creations:
💬 Join the Official Discord

🧩 Wishlist now and try the demo before Early Access drops June 17.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+ 64-bit (latest version)
  • Processor: 8-core Intel i7/i9 or AMD Ryzen 7/9
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 Super or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Sneak out of the office without getting caught in this stealth puzzle game. Distract coworkers, dodge HR, and outsmart your boss—or build your own chaotic office layouts and share them on the Steam Workshop. Escape begins June 17!
